comment: Surface keys with no keyless scenario yet. Every entry states why it is uncovered and the exit condition that removes it; `npm run check` fails when a new key appears without a scenario or a debt entry, and when an entry goes stale.

entries.reason: A revision verdict requires a finding and a re-review round; the review scenario must include both.
entries.exitCondition: The review-merge scenario records a needs_revision verdict and a follow-up pass; delete this entry.

entries.reason: A reject verdict blocks the topic and has no current keyless path.
entries.exitCondition: Add a rejection branch to the review-merge scenario or remove the state from the public matrix with a reviewed source change; delete this entry.

entries.reason: No shipped tool or route abandons a work item; the state exists for the store contract and migration.
entries.exitCondition: If a public abandon path lands, map it to a scenario; if the state is retired from the public contract, drop it from the matrix. Then delete this entry.

entries.reason: The route asks the host to reveal a file through the native OS opener; a headless keyless lane must not drive a user-visible desktop action.
entries.exitCondition: Cover it in the browser lane or add an injectable opener to the host harness, then delete this entry.
